cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor; absent when no further notes are known.

book.description: AT-URI of the catalog edition whose notes to list.

following.description: When true, only notes by accounts `viewer` follows are returned. With no `viewer` the answer is an empty page: a follow graph cannot be evaluated for nobody.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.

tag.description: Filter to notes carrying this exact tag. Tags are free-form, so the match is verbatim: `Travel` and `travel` are different labels. Absent or empty lists every note, tagged or not.

viewer.description: The account whose follow graph `following` filters against. Ignored when `following` is false or absent.

note.description: One published note. `text` is the note's body and is always present; the quotation, anchor, colour and tags are the annotation's own optional fields and are dropped when the record left them out.

color.description: The highlight colour the reader chose, as their app spells it.

createdAt.description: When the note's record was first published.

did.description: The reader whose repo holds the note.

displayName.description: The name on the reader's own Livtet profile record. Absent when no profile has been indexed.

handle.description: The reader's current handle, from the deployment's public handle view. Absent when the index has not seen the account's handle.

kind.description: `note` when the annotation carries words; `highlight` when it marks a passage with no words yet.

locator.description: The reader's own anchor: a page, a clock time, a chapter, a CFI. Formats differ between readers, so a consumer may not be able to open it locally.

pageNumber.description: The printed page the note was taken on, when the reader's format has one.

quote.description: The passage the note was taken on.

tags.description: The labels the reader put on this note, in their own spelling. Absent when the record carried none.

text.description: The note's body. Empty on a highlight, whose `quote` names the passage it marks.

uri.description: AT-URI of the `readingProgress` record the note lives in; a share link and a reports queue both name it.

description: List the notes readers published on one catalog edition, newest first. A note is a `readingProgress` record whose `annotation.text` is non-empty; an annotation that marks a passage with no words yet (a highlight) is listed too, with an empty `text` and `kind` `highlight`. A position record carries no note, and a blank annotation with no passage marks nothing, so neither is listed. With `following` set and a `viewer` supplied, only notes by accounts the viewer follows are returned. With `tag` set, only notes carrying that exact label are returned.
